area: Inline Add and Edit Parts - Full View Edit
title: Full View Edit opens the part details modal pre-populated
permissions_required: Work Order Line - Create and Edit; Work Order View Mode
preconditions: A work order is open with status Estimate, Approved, In Progress, or Review.
You have the 'Work Order Line - Create and Edit' setting enabled.
Your 'Work Orders → Work Order View Mode' permission is set to Full View.
The work order line already has at least one part on it.
steps: Select Edit on an existing part line.
expected:
1. The part details modal opens, pre-populated with the part's current values.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9315 and story SV-9320 (Story 5, Edit Part - Full View) and the Inline Add and Edit Parts on Work Order Lines specification version 16, section S5-R1, read on 31 August 2026.
